_comment: TECH v0.3 placeholder text only. NOT the locked Celes script. IDs are assigned in order starting at $1001 ($1000 is the reserved out-of-range diagnostic). Max ~30 characters per line, 4 lines per box. Every line is width-checked at build time against the ROM font width table (C4:8FC0): max 220 px (engine wrap limit $C8=$E0 minus start x 4).

messages.label: enter_prompt
messages.text: TECH v0.3: Annex test map.{n}Enter the Annex?{n}{choice} Yes{n}{choice} No

messages.label: vale_first
messages.text: VALE (placeholder): TECH v0.3.{n}This text is from bank F3.{n}Annex flag STARTED is now ON.{n}The north door is unsealed.

messages.label: vale_started
messages.text: VALE (placeholder):{n}Annex flag STARTED is still ON.{n}Go north through the door{n}to start the test battle.

messages.label: vale_battle
messages.text: VALE (placeholder):{n}Annex flag BATTLE DONE is ON.{n}Take the test reward from{n}the chest in the north room.

messages.label: vale_done
messages.text: VALE (placeholder):{n}Annex flag COMPLETE is ON.{n}TECH slice finished. Exit{n}south to return to the Falcon.

messages.label: door_sealed
messages.text: The door is sealed.{n}(Talk to VALE first.)

messages.label: battle_done
messages.text: Defenses are down.{n}Annex flag BATTLE DONE is ON.

messages.label: reward_get
messages.text: TECH v0.3 placeholder reward:{n}Received 1 Potion.{n}Annex flag COMPLETE is ON.

messages.label: chest_empty
messages.text: The chest is empty.{n}(Reward already taken.)
